properties.name: The one-graph choices settled: a typed cross-design link, move-or-decompose never copy, and the five linking fixes kept as intent; the family check left as considered
properties.rationale: The cross-design link is the shared piece the duplicate warning, slice 3, the ripple and the root-cause neighbours pass all need, so it is built before slice 3. properties.subject: record
properties.summary: Four open choices settled on Anthony's "Go with your picks". (1) A relation into another design is a typed link kept in the design that makes it. (2) Checking the family for duplicates and misplaced facts stays considered until one search across designs and the link exist, and a manual check measures the rate. (3) Slice 3 moves or decomposes and never copies; a decision flows down as derived requirements. (4) The linking fixes F1–F5 are intent. BUILD ORDER: 1 merge #696; 2 the root-cause skill change with F4; 3 F2+F3; 4 the cross-design link; 5 slice 3; 6 F1+F5; 7 the family check, revisited with a measured rate.
